Name: A Bow for Abigail's Portrait
Author: ClockworkAngels
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/N0GPwvf.png[/img][/center]
[left]This mod very simply uses the EditImage/Overlay function of Content Patcher to add a bow to Abigail's portrait without editing the portraits themselves. This means that it will apply to almost any portrait mod you use, though results may vary. It will look best with vanilla-like portraits, and it is guaranteed to work with vanilla and Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic.[/left]
[center]﻿~*~[/center]
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/Xf46N9Y.png[/img] [/center]
Install the requirements first. Drop this mod into your mods folder.

Manifest.Name: A Bow for Abigail's Portrait
Manifest.Description: A bow overlay for Abigail that works with any portrait.
